intro: The opening song of Blood on the Tracks and the one he has rewritten most openly. The story jumps between people, places and times, and Dylan has kept moving its pieces around for fifty years.

lives.title: The New York version
lives.note: Recorded quietly with a small band, and pressed on the first test copies of the album. Released in 1991 on The Bootleg Series Vol. 1–3, and the full session on More Blood, More Tracks.

lives.title: Re-cut in Minneapolis
lives.note: Just before release he re-recorded it with local musicians his brother found, faster and brighter. This is the version on Blood on the Tracks, January 1975.

lives.title: Rolling Thunder
lives.place: New Haven Veterans Memorial Coliseum, New Haven
lives.note: Played in the acoustic part of the 1975 shows. Recordings from the tour came out in 2019.

lives.title: Heavily revised
lives.note: Solo acoustic with many lines rewritten — some verses close to new. Dylan said he preferred the imagery. Released on Real Live.

lives.title: Never Ending Tour fixture
lives.note: In the late 1990s it was in nearly every show, usually acoustic with a long guitar coda, more than 100 times a year from 1998 to 2000.

lives.title: Still changing
lives.note: In the 2010s the words kept shifting from tour to tour, with whole verses reworked again.

others.note: A long-running part of Garcia's live sets.
